text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Carrying the club's expectations. 
Carrying Hayahide's expectations. 
Carrying my Trainer's expectations, I 
run.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(—And yours too, Brian. 
Taking upon myself even your 
expectations—!!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhh!
choice_data_list: (—I always believed in Phalaenopsis.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After braving that grueling summer and 
perfecting her form, 
I knew she could achieve even the Triple 
Tiara. 
Even so...
choice_data_list: She did it...! She really pulled it off!!

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Phaleno-san...! ...I'm at a loss for 
words!! 
To think... she's actually accomplished it 
once again...!

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Just a single GⅠ victory is incredible 
enough!! 
She did it! She really—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: She's achieved the Triple Tiara!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: *Hah, hah, hah...*
choice_data_list: Congratulations...! Congratulations!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ————Well done.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Did you witness it? We have done it. 
—The Triple Tiara is ours!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand? This was not achieved 
by me alone. 
Nor was it achieved by you alone.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: We accomplished this together.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Thus—these three crowns are not something 
for my hands alone to hold aloft.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come, thrust your fist into the air as 
well. 
Let us raise a cry of triumph. For now—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: That makes three.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, thank you!!
...Yeah, thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tears welled in my eyes as I watched her, 
raising my fist high. 
Hastily wiping them away, I joined in the 
applause.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I was overwhelmed with sheer joy. 
That I was able to play a part in this 
future. 
That I could contribute to her proud, 
magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! It's the Triple Tiara! 
She actually won it! That's the first time 
I've ever seen it won!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis is from that club, right? 
The one surrounded by nature... Maybe I'll 
start 
following how the other girls from that 
club are doing, too.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(This is fine. At the end of this 
continued path lies the sight 
I long for—the view I wish to bring to the 
club.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (That future is surely not far off now.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I shall acknowledge it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Today is truly an auspicious day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Tch. 
Taking it all on your shoulders without 
asking.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...When I get back, you're giving it back 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —That belongs to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a few days after achieving the 
Triple Tiara—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To a Japanese garden? 
Taking time off from training just for 
that?
choice_data_list: Yeah, the club prepared tickets for us.
Yeah, the club got us tickets.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explain that it's a gift to celebrate 
achieving the 
Triple Tiara. And so—
choice_data_list: How about going to take a breather?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(We have fulfilled yet another great 
ambition. 
Which is precisely why... it is true our 
focus could easily slip.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Part of me thinks we should not slacken, 
that 
we ought to tighten our belts and stay 
vigilant, but...)
choice_data_list: Ooh. Looks like a pretty gorgeous place.
Wow. Looks like a really beautiful place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I open a travel magazine to show her the 
garden. 
Its pages reveal a scene of elegant, 
tranquil beauty.
choice_data_list:
What do you think? Relaxing once in a 
while sounds nice, right?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Let us go together. 
Tell me what date you had in mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, on the day of my promised outing 
with Phalaenopsis—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It truly cleanses the spirit... It is by 
no means lavish. 
Which is precisely why I feel the essence 
of wabi-sabi.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
That rock garden earlier was a work of 
art. 
The artisan's craftsmanship shone down to 
the finest detail. 
I was utterly captivated for a time.
choice_data_list: Yeah, totally!
Yeah, it really was!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking through the Japanese garden with 
Phalaenopsis... 
It had been a long time since I enjoyed 
such tranquil peace.
choice_data_list:
Oh, look. There's a sweet shop over there, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. 
Dumplings over flowers, an appetite over 
aesthetics?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Very well, very well. Let us go. 
Eat as much as your heart desires.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I did say you could buy as much as you 
liked. 
Yet I hardly expected you to buy so much 
you could scarcely carry it.
choice_data_list:
I wanted to get souvenirs for the club, 
and I guess I got carried away...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Would it not have been wiser to purchase 
them on our 
way home, once we had finished viewing the 
grounds?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. 
You careless scatterbrain.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come now, give half the burden to me. 
Allow your dependable mentor to lend a 
hand.
choice_data_list: You're always saving my skin...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: *munch, munch... munch, munch...*
choice_data_list: How is it? Is the taiyaki good?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Delicious!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It brings out the natural sweetness of the 
azuki beans exquisitely—truly a 
masterpiece! 
Anyone who favors coarse bean paste would 
inevitably be enchanted.
choice_data_list: Hehe... Want to buy another one?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Now, now, Trainer. 
Do not whisper such sweet temptations.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Strictly from a dietary standpoint, today 
I have already 
indulged in dango, soba, and taiyaki—far 
too much. 
Therefore, I have no need for 'another 
one.'

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Please, do not entice me.
choice_data_list: Then how about splitting one with me?
Then how about splitting one with me?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
............You truly are adept at 
offering sweet treats, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. To think it has already grown this 
late... 
I let myself unwind a bit too much, it 
seems.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Well... heh. 
Once in a while should do no harm.
choice_data_list: I'm glad you were able to unwind!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. And it would have pained me to 
dismiss 
the club's thoughtful consideration, after 
all.
choice_data_list: ...Um, about that, actually...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't keep up the lie forever. 
Bracing myself for a reprimand, I 
confessed the truth.
choice_data_list:
The truth is, I was the one who got the 
Japanese garden tickets.

The truth is, I was the one who got the 
Japanese garden tickets.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is that so?
choice_data_list:
The club's celebration party will be held 
another day.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I see... Why tell such a falsehood? 
Could you not have simply told me the 
truth 
from the beginning—that you were the one 
who arranged it?
choice_data_list:
I wanted to use 'the club's kindness' as 
an excuse...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is sensible. When it came to 
'necessary rest,' 
she could take it appropriately. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She would never ask for a 'simple day off' 
on her own. 
She would rest if given one, but she was 
never the type 
to seek a break for recreation or personal 
pleasure.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, watching her push forward 
relentlessly without a break 
until she claimed the Triple Tiara—
choice_data_list:
I just wanted you to take a pause for at 
least a day.

I just wanted you to take a pause for at 
least a day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I figured that even she would accept 
resting if it came 
in the form of a 'Triple Tiara reward' 
specially arranged by the club.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
So that was it... 
Here I had thought—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh, pulling one over on your own master. 
You certainly have nerve.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
However... yes, quite. 
Vexing though it is to admit, it went just 
as you intended.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I feel thoroughly refreshed. 
You have my gratitude.
choice_data_list: I'm so glad to hear that...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Shall we visit again when next we achieve 
our goal? 
Not just once or twice—as many times as we 
wish.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
If such a reward awaits me, 
it feels as though I could grasp any 
ambition.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. 
What shall our next step be?
choice_data_list:
...About that, there's something I'd like 
to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From her debut to the Shuka Sho, 
Phalaenopsis had 
relentlessly pushed herself to the brink 
for her goal.
choice_data_list: —So, let's slow the pace down around here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering Phalaenopsis's future, 
keeping the engine running hot like this 
would be dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before she exhausted all her strength and 
wore herself out. 
I judged that we should pause and catch 
our breath here... 
and aim for results once again after that.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, I see. 
You make a valid point.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Conveniently enough, there are no 
Tiara-route races 
in the near future. There is no need to 
rush, then.
choice_data_list:
So let's make your next race the Milers 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Milers Cup takes place in late April 
of next year. 
After building up her strength until then, 
she will return to the front lines.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Understood. 
It is all so that I may continue to run 
through the Twinkle Series, after all.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Let us do this, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Right!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To make our club the most beautiful 
garden"— 
If we kept going like this, that dream was 
within her reach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Or at least, so I thought at the time.
